note: Rows the mod adds to the method library's reference tables (data/biological_variation.json, data/effects.jsonl). A row whose key or id the library already has is not used: the library's own row wins. Every number is quoted from its source.

cvi_source.title: Carobene A et al. Biological variation estimates obtained from 91 healthy study participants for 9 enzymes in serum (EuBIVAS). Clin Chem 2017;63(6):1141-50
cvi_source.note: EuBIVAS: 91 healthy adults (21-69 y), weekly for 10 weeks; the abstract gives point estimates without CIs. The paper reports a sex difference for ALT; this is the pooled estimate.
cvi_source.quote: The following estimates for within-subject BV (CVI) and between-subject BV (CVG), respectively, were obtained: ALT: 9.3%, 28.2%

effects.intervention: More-intensive weight loss interventions (15 behavioural programmes, 6 drug, 1 surgical) vs no or lower-intensity intervention in NAFLD
effects.population: 非酒精性脂肪肝的成人（平均 45 岁，约 2/3 为男性）
effects.quote: Weight loss interventions were statistically significantly associated with improvements in biomarkers, including alanine aminotransferase (-9.81 U/L; 95% CI, -13.12 to -6.50; I2 = 97%)
effects.note_zh: 22 项随机试验合并（15 项行为减重计划、6 项药物、1 项手术），干预中位 6 个月，平均比对照多减 3.6 kg；肝脏脂肪也明显减少。试验之间差别很大（I² 97%）。有 3 位作者另外获得减重代餐公司的资助（与本研究无关）。

effects.intervention: DASH diet vs typical American diet, controlled feeding, body weight kept constant (DASH-Sodium, crossover)
effects.population: 血压偏高的成人（103 人，美国，平均 52 岁；喂养期间体重保持不变）
effects.quote: The DASH diet reduced serum UA (-0.35 mg/dl [95% confidence interval (95% CI) -0.65, -0.05], P = 0.02), with a higher effect (-1.29 mg/dl [95% CI -2.50, -0.08]) among participants (n = 8) with a baseline serum UA level of ≥7 mg/dl.
effects.note_zh: 交叉喂养试验，每期 30 天，饭菜由研究提供，体重不变。基线尿酸 ≥7 mg/dL（约 416 μmol/L）的 8 人平均降得更多（−1.29 mg/dL）。
